Complete [[Riverside Province]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Claim the [[Scepter of Orr]].
* *BONUS* Take out all nine watchtowers.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Riverside Province#Walkthrough| Riverside Province]] mission.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Mission]]
:''"The Scepter of Orr is the key to [[Tyria]]'s future. Patriots are needed in [[Riverside Province (outpost)|Riverside Province]] to claim this ancient relic."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = The battle rages on! All able-bodied heroes should hasten to defend those bravely protecting [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. }}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*It is significantly easier and faster to complete the mission in hard mode and then do the first bonus in [[normal mode]] (assuming you don't need the [[hard mode]] bonus for the [[Guardian of Tyria]] title).
